Definition: Etham, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: ʼÊthâm was a place in the wilderness, on the way out of Egypt. The name occurs 4 times, most often in Numbers. There is no People profile for it, because it is a place, not a person.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼÊthâm matters because Scripture bothered to record the name. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
